name: facet
description: Runtime pass set copied from ncoevoet/facet: scoring passes, duplicate, burst/blink culling, diagnostics.

features.name: quality_pass
features.description: Per-image quality-like scoring pass from available image metadata.

features.name: composition_pass
features.description: Heuristic composition features and exposure/quality proxies.

features.name: duplicate_pass
features.description: Exact duplicate detection by hash with grouped duplicate map.

features.name: burst_blink_pass
features.description: Burst and similarity-based culling candidates ordered by capture time (file mtime, not EXIF), using pixel-embedding cosine similarity and an eye-open proxy; filename is only a fallback.

features.name: diagnostics_pass
features.description: Runtime diagnostics output for ingest and processing traceability.
